errors.text_span: den Anteil der Ausgaben für Verkehrsinvestitionen in Prozent des Bruttoinlandsprodukts (BIP)
errors.evidence: The figure shows investments of territorial authorities (Brutto- and Nettoanlageinvestitionen), not specifically traffic/transport investments. The atom checklist and image title indicate general investments, not restricted to traffic.
The left diagram shows grouped bars, not stacked bars. The bars for Bund, Länder, and Gemeinden are side-by-side, not stacked on top of each other.

errors.text_span: der Bund in den frühen 1990er Jahren etwa 0,8 % des BIP ausgab, die Länder etwa 0,7 % und die Gemeinden etwa 1,6 %, was zusammen einen Gesamtwert von rund 3,1 % ergab
errors.evidence: The description provides specific values for Bund, Länder, and Gemeinden in the early 1990s, but the image shows approximate combined values near 3.1% for Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt (black line), not exact breakdowns for each category. The values for individual categories are not clearly distinguishable to this precision.

errors.text_span: der unterste Teil in Blau repräsentiert den Bund, der mittlere Teil in Lila die Länder und der oberste Teil in Grün die Gemeinden
errors.evidence: The left diagram shows grouped bars, not stacked, so there is no 'unterste', 'mittlere', or 'oberste' part. This description incorrectly implies a stacked structure.

The description does not explicitly mention that the right diagram shows net investments (Nettoanlageinvestitionen), only referring to 'dieselben Daten', which is incorrect as the right diagram shows different data (net vs. gross).
The description omits the negative range (-0.5) on the y-axis for the right diagram, which is important for interpreting net investments.
The description does not mention that net investments (right diagram) dipped into the negative range after the early 1990s.

errors.text_span: wobei eine vertikale gestrichelte Linie den Zeitpunkt der Bahnreform im Jahr 2000 markiert
errors.evidence: The image does not contain a vertical dashed line marking the Bahnreform. The Bahnreform label is attached to an arrow pointing to the black line, not a vertical line.

errors.text_span: während die Ausgaben des Bundes und der Länder über die Zeit relativ stabil blieben
errors.evidence: The description oversimplifies the trends in the right diagram. The Länder (violet) show a clear decline over time, not relative stability.

errors.text_span: dieselben Daten als separate Balken dargestellt
errors.evidence: The phrase 'dieselben Daten' is misleading, as the right diagram shows net investments, not the same data as the left diagram (gross investments).
